children: updated investors this week that its $560M financing package will help its planned $4B Bronx casino resort move forward. The funds will go toward pre-construction planning and help Bally's
stay on schedule while it completes the broader capital raise. The loan is expected to close during the current quarter, subject to approvals and customary conditions.
In its application materials in New York, Bally's
set a construction timeline of eight to nine months after securing a license and a single-phase opening sometime in 2030.
The project, known as Bally’s Bronx, is planned for a 16-acre portion of Bally’s Golf Links at Ferry Point near the Whitestone Bridge—land formerly associated with Trump Golf Links. Bally's
bought the key city-owned parcel for about $156.6M earlier this year, giving it control of the clubhouse, parking, and access areas needed for the development.

Plans call for a roughly 3M-square-foot, 19-story waterfront complex. Key elements include a casino with approximately 3,500 slot machines, about 210 table games and poker; a 500-room hotel; more than 10 food-and-beverage venues; a 2,000-person event or convention center; and about 4,600 parking spaces. Bally's
has also proposed retaining golf- and park-related amenities around the resort and investing more than $160M in nearby Ferry Point Park and Throggs Neck improvements.

title: Bally's lands key financing for its Bronx casino resort project
